from pathlib import Path


def resolve_inside(root, relative):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    target = (root / relative).resolve()
    if not str(target).startswith(str(root)):
        raise ValueError('outside workspace')
    return target

files.test_records.py:
from records import valid_records


def test_filters_invalid_records():
    records = [
        {'name': 'Ada', 'age': 20},
        {'name': '', 'age': 30},
        {'name': 'Bob', 'age': -1},
        {'name': 'Eve', 'age': True},
        {'name': 'Lin', 'age': 0},
    ]
    assert valid_records(records) == [records[0], records[4]]


def test_missing_fields():
    assert valid_records([{}, {'name': 'Ada'}]) == []
